contexts.text: This is represented by the impurities in the blood, from which it is to be defecated; this defecation is effected by means of violent motions...
That his truth must be defecated from impure loves. Signified.
To purify the sons of Levi, and to purge them as gold and silver = the purification of good and truth from evils and falsities.
So far the love is defecated from its impurities, and is purified...
Lees, and lees well refined () = truths from that good, with the happiness therefrom.
3. This may be illustrated by the defecation of the blood in the lungs...
